title: Conditional: Futuro do Pretérito
summary: Use faria, poderia, and gostaria to talk about hypothetical actions and polite requests.

sections.heading: Form and basic meaning
sections.body:
The conditional, called **futuro do pretérito**, adds endings to the infinitive: **-ia, -ia, -íamos, -iam**. It expresses 'would' and is useful for hypothetical situations.

| Subject | falar | comer | abrir |
|---|---|---|---|
| eu | **falaria** | **comeria** | **abriria** |
| você/ele/ela | **falaria** | **comeria** | **abriria** |
| nós | **falaríamos** | **comeríamos** | **abriríamos** |
| vocês/eles/elas | **falariam** | **comeriam** | **abririam** |

examples.pt: Eu viajaria mais se tivesse dinheiro.
examples.en: I would travel more if I had money.
She would live near the beach.
We would buy a bigger apartment.

sections.heading: Polite requests
sections.body: The conditional makes requests softer. **Gostaria**, **poderia**, and **daria para** are extremely useful in Brazil.

examples.pt: Eu gostaria de uma água, por favor.
examples.en: I would like a water, please.
Would it be possible to wait five minutes?

sections.heading: Common irregular stems
sections.body:
Some verbs use modified stems, but the endings are the same.

| Subject | fazer | dizer | trazer |
|---|---|---|---|
| eu | **faria** | **diria** | **traria** |
| você/ele/ela | **faria** | **diria** | **traria** |
| nós | **faríamos** | **diríamos** | **traríamos** |
| vocês/eles/elas | **fariam** | **diriam** | **trariam** |

keyPoints: Conditional endings attach to the infinitive for most verbs.
Eu and você/ele/ela have the same conditional form.
Use the conditional for would, hypothetical results, and polite requests.
Gostaria de is the safest polite way to say 'I would like'.
Irregular stems include faria, diria, traria.

commonMistakes.note: Use gostaria de for polite requests.
